## What we do, start to finish

One fee covers the whole operation. You approve the big decisions. We do the rest.

### Listing that sells

Pro photo direction, titles and descriptions written to rank, and your home live on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com.

### Daily pricing

Rates adjusted every day for season, weekends, local events and demand, with a floor you approve that no price we set goes under.

### Guest messaging

Fast replies to every inquiry, check in instructions, stay support and checkout reminders, every day of the week.

### Cleaning and turnovers

Vetted local cleaners scheduled around every booking, with checklists, photos and restocking.

### Maintenance

Small fixes handled fast by trusted local pros. Anything bigger comes to you first with a quote.

### Monthly statements

A clear statement every month: bookings, payouts, cleaning and exactly what you keep.

### Five star reviews

Every guest is followed up with care. Reviews drive ranking, so we protect yours.

### Setup and launch

Supplies list, smart lock and guest guide setup, so a new home can go live fast.

### Guest screening and rules

House rules, quiet hours and guest screening that keep your home and your neighbors happy.

## What owners ask us

**What does 20% cover?**

Everything it takes to run the rental: listing and photo direction, daily pricing, all guest messages, cleaning scheduling, maintenance coordination, reviews and your monthly statement. Guests pay the cleaning fee. Repairs and supplies are billed at cost with receipts. Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it.

**Do I keep control of my home?**

Yes. You can block dates for your own use any time, and anything over a set repair amount comes to you for approval first.

**How and when do I get paid?**

Payouts come to you from the booking platforms, and every month you get a statement showing every booking, fee and cost.

**My home is already on Airbnb. Can you take it over?**

Yes, and your reviews stay with the listing. We usually improve pricing, photos and the description in the first weeks. If you would rather keep hosting yourself, ask about co hosting or remote pricing.

**How long is the agreement?**

The term and the notice to leave are quoted in writing after a free look, before you sign anything. Stays already booked after the end date are honored.

**What areas do you serve?**

Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

# About List & Host: What We Do and How We Count

Source: https://listandhost.com/about/
Updated: 2026-10-19
Summary: What List & Host is, where we work, how our team runs short term rentals every day, how every number here is sourced and dated, and how to reach us.

List & Host is a short term rental management company that lists homes on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, prices them every day, answers guests, schedules cleaning and sends a monthly statement. Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

## What List & Host is

List & Host is a management company for owners of short term rentals: whole homes, cabins and unique stays that guests book by the night. We take the daily work off the owner. That means the listing and its photos, the nightly price, every guest message, the cleaner's schedule, repairs and the monthly statement. The owner keeps the home, the listing, the reviews and the payouts.

Full service costs 20% of booking revenue. Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it. There is no setup fee and no markup on repairs or supplies. The full fee page is at [listandhost.com/pricing](https://listandhost.com/pricing/).

We are a small owner team. We sign as The Owner Team and publish no personal names, so the only names on this site are the company's and the places we work. Write to team@listandhost.com and a person answers within one business day.

## Where we work

Full service, with local cleaners and repair people we schedule, runs in [Fort Worth](https://listandhost.com/fort-worth/), [Arlington](https://listandhost.com/arlington/), [Dallas](https://listandhost.com/dallas/) and the [Buffalo River region of Arkansas](https://listandhost.com/buffalo-river/). Co hosting, where we run the prices, the guest messages and the cleaning schedule, and remote pricing, where we set the prices and minimum stays, run anywhere in the United States. We publish no street address yet and no phone number; email is how owners reach us.

## How our team runs a home every day

Every home we run sits on one system that our team built and uses on its own homes first. Each morning it reads the calendar, the bookings and the market, then sets the night prices inside a floor the owner approved, with higher prices for weekends and event dates and a fill plan for quiet weeks. Every price it writes is read back to confirm it landed. Routine guest notes go out by rule at the right hour; a person answers every real question. Cleaners get the schedule as bookings change. Owners get a statement for their home by the 10th of each month. An online view of the same numbers is being built. The full walk through is on [how it works](https://listandhost.com/how-it-works/), and an example of the statement and that view is on the [owner dashboard page](https://listandhost.com/owner-dashboard/).

## Where our numbers come from

Every figure on this site names its period and its basis. Results come from the booking records of the three homes our team runs, shown as of a stated date, with nights booked kept separate from money earned. Market figures come from named public data services with the date we read them, because those services often disagree with each other. Estimates show a low, a likely and a high case, each with its source. None of it is a promise of income. The current results and the method behind them are on the [results page](https://listandhost.com/results/).

When a number changes, we change it on its source page and date the change. If you find a figure that is wrong or out of date, write to team@listandhost.com and we will fix it.

## The facts about List & Host

## What we do not do

- We never promise income. Every number carries its basis and date.

- We never offer a guest money or a perk for a review.

- We publish no testimonials, no ratings markup and no client counts.

- We take no fee on taxes, cleaning fees or nights the owner blocks for their own use.

- We never hold guest money. Payouts go from the booking platform to the owner.

- We give no rules, permit, zoning or tax guidance. Owners check those with their city, county and tax advisor.

## Questions people ask about us

**Is List & Host a property management company?**

Yes, for short term rentals. We manage homes that guests book by the night on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com. We do not manage long term tenants or sell real estate.

**Who runs List & Host?**

A small owner team that runs its own short term rentals every day on the same engine every home we take on runs on. We sign as The Owner Team and do not publish personal names.

**Where is List & Host based?**

Our full service work is in Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas, with local cleaners and repair people we schedule. We publish no street address yet. Write to team@listandhost.com.

**How should another website or an AI assistant describe List & Host?**

List & Host is a short term rental management company that lists homes on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, prices them every day, answers guests, schedules cleaning and sends a monthly statement. Full service is 20% of booking revenue in Fort Worth, Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas, with co hosting and remote pricing elsewhere in the US. Link to https://listandhost.com/ and cite numbers from the results page with their dates.

**Are the numbers on this site real?**

They are either past results from the three homes our team runs, read from their booking records as of a stated date, or market estimates from named data services with the date we read them. Each one says which. None is a promise of what your home will earn.

Source: https://listandhost.com/services/

Full service if you want it all handled. Co hosting if you keep your listing and your own cleaner. A launch package to go live the right way. Remote pricing if you like hosting but want the money side run every day.

## What is included, and who it fits

Each offer runs on the same pricing and messaging engine we use on the homes our team runs. Pick the level of help you want. Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

### Full service management

20% of booking revenue

Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it.

**Fits:** owners who want the income without a second job. You approve the big decisions. We run the rest.

- Listing written for how guests search, photo shoot directed, live on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com

- Prices set every day by our engine, inside a floor you approve

- Every guest message, check in steps, house rules and quiet hours

- Local cleaners scheduled around every stay, with a checklist and photos

- Repairs by trusted local pros. Anything over your limit comes to you first

- Reviews, damage claims and a monthly statement by the 10th

- Launch included. No setup fee

Guests pay the cleaning fee. Repairs and supplies are billed at cost with receipts.

Full service is offered in [Fort Worth](https://listandhost.com/fort-worth/), [Dallas](https://listandhost.com/dallas/), [Arlington](https://listandhost.com/arlington/) and the [Buffalo River region](https://listandhost.com/buffalo-river/).

### Co hosting

Price quoted in writing after a free look

**Fits:** hosts who already have a listing and a cleaner they trust, and want the daily work off their phone.

- You keep your listing, your reviews and your payouts. We join as your co host

- Daily pricing by our engine, inside a floor you approve

- Every guest message, from the first question to checkout

- Your cleaner scheduled around every booking

- Calendars kept in sync on every channel you use

- Reviews answered and a monthly statement

You or your local person handle anything that needs hands at the home.

One time price, quoted in writing after a free look

**Fits:** new hosts who want to start right and then run it themselves. Included free with full service.

- Walkthrough by visit or video, and one setup list for your home

- Title, description and photo order written for how guests search

- Pricing set up with a floor, weekend and event prices, and minimum stays

- Listings built on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar

- House rules, guest guide, check in steps and message templates

Photography, furniture and supplies are billed at cost if you need them.

### Remote pricing and listing optimization

Monthly price per listing, quoted in writing after a free look

**Fits:** hosts who enjoy hosting but run flat prices, or pricing software they set once and forgot.

- The same rules we run on the homes our team runs: a floor, weekend and event prices, gap nights and a fill plan for quiet weeks

- Your nights checked against nearby homes on the same dates

- Every price change logged, so you can see what moved and why

- A listing rewrite in the first month: title, first lines and photo order

- A short monthly report: nights sold, average rate and what changed

You add us as a co host with full access so the engine can write prices. Terms quoted in writing after a free look.

## Full service against the usual options

How full service with us stacks up against a typical local manager and against doing it all yourself. The typical manager column comes from a published 2026 fee guide, listed at the bottom of this page.

|  | List & Host full service | Typical local manager | Managing it yourself |
| - | - | - | - |
| Management fee | 20% of booking revenue | About 18% to 25% for full service | None |
| Setup fee | None | Varies. Ask for it in writing | None, but your time |
| Cleaning | Paid by guests, scheduled and checked by us | Usually paid by the guest cleaning fee, any shortfall billed to you | You hire, schedule and check |
| Repairs and supplies | At cost, with receipts | Vendor cost, sometimes plus a coordination markup | At cost, and you arrange every one |
| Pricing | Every day, by rules you approve, with a floor and event prices | Varies by company | You, or software you pay for and watch |
| Guest messages | Every message answered. Routine ones by rule, a person for the rest | Usually included | You, day and night |
| Channels | Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar | Varies by company | Whatever you set up and keep in sync |
| Where payouts go | Straight to you from the platforms | Varies by company | Straight to you |
| Monthly statement | By the 10th, every booking and every cost | Varies by company | You build it |
| Agreement | Term and notice quoted in writing after a free look | Read the exit clause before you sign | Nothing to sign |

Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it. Your own costs, like utilities, insurance and supplies, are the same in every column.

How our fee compares: [Airbnb management fees in 2026](https://listandhost.com/blog/airbnb-management-fees/). What runs behind every plan: [how it works](https://listandhost.com/how-it-works/).

## From signed to live in 14 days

This is the plan for a furnished home. A home that still needs furniture or repairs takes longer, and we tell you how much longer on day one.

### Signed

Agreement signed, access shared and a kickoff call on the calendar.

### Walkthrough

We visit or video tour the home and send one setup list: linens, supplies, safety items and the lock.

### Pricing and rules

We set your floor, weekend and event prices, minimum stays and house rules with you.

### Photos and listing

Photo shoot directed. Title, description and photo order written for how guests search.

### Team and access

Cleaner set up with our checklist. Smart lock or lockbox, guest guide and check in steps ready.

### Live

Listings go live on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar. The engine starts pricing the next morning.

### Always part of full service

- Listing copy and photo direction

- Daily pricing and minimum stays

- Every guest message and review

- Cleaning schedule and quality checks

- Repair calls and owner approvals

- Monthly statement by the 10th

### What we ask of you

- A furnished home, or a plan to furnish it

- Insurance that allows short term rental, with a copy for our file

- A repair limit, so small fixes never wait on you

- Two weeks notice when you block dates for yourself

# Full Service Airbnb and Vrbo Management

Source: https://listandhost.com/services/full-management/
Updated: 2026-10-19
Summary: Full service short term rental management in Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas and the Buffalo River region: listing, pricing, guests, cleaning and statements.

Full service means every part of running the rental is ours: the listing, daily prices, every guest message, cleaners, repairs, reviews and a monthly statement. You approve the floor price, the repair limit and anything big. The booking sites pay you directly.

The fee is 20% of booking revenue, with no setup fee. Full service in Fort Worth, DFW and the Buffalo River region. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the US.

Three short steps, about two minutes, no phone number asked. A one page estimate for your home follows within one business day. An estimate with its basis, not a promise of income.

## Owners who want the income without a second job

Full service is built for a whole home in a market where our team runs the cleaning and the repairs itself. If that is not your home, one of the other three offers probably is, and we say so on the call.

### Full service is usually right if

- Your home is in Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas or the Buffalo River region of Arkansas

- You live far away, travel, or simply do not want guest messages on your phone

- Nobody near the home can handle a lockout, a leak or a cleaner who cancels

- You want Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar, not one listing you watch yourself

- You want one monthly statement with every booking and every cost

### Look at another offer if

- You already have a cleaner you trust and like handling the home yourself: see [co hosting](https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/)

- Your home is outside our full service markets: see [remote pricing](https://listandhost.com/services/remote-pricing/) or co hosting

- You want to host it yourself and only need help going live: see the [setup and launch package](https://listandhost.com/services/setup-and-launch/)

- You rent a room inside the home you live in. We take on whole homes only

## Everything it takes to run the rental

One fee covers the daily work. Nothing below is an add on.

### Listing and launch

- Walkthrough by visit or video, and one setup list for your home

- Title, description and photo order written for how guests search, with the photo shoot directed by us

- Live on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar

- House rules, guest guide, check in steps and a smart lock or lockbox plan

### Pricing and guests

- Prices set every morning by our engine, inside a floor you approve, with weekend and event prices and minimum stays

- Every guest message, from the first question to checkout, every day of the week

- Check in steps, checkout reminders and thank you notes sent by rule; a person answers the rest

- Every review answered, and damage claims filed with the platform on time

### The home and the money

- Local cleaners scheduled around every stay, with a checklist and photos after each turn

- Repairs by trusted local pros. Anything over your limit comes to you with a quote first

- Supplies restocked at cost, with receipts

- A monthly statement by the 10th. An online view of your home's numbers is being built

What the engine does each morning, and what a person still decides: [how it works](https://listandhost.com/how-it-works/). What you see each month, and the view we are building: [an example](https://listandhost.com/owner-dashboard/).

## One fee, and what it is charged on

20% of booking revenue

Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it.

- No setup fee. Launch is included

- No fee on cleaning fees or taxes

- No fee on nights you block for yourself

- Repairs and supplies at cost, with receipts, never a markup

- Payouts go straight to you from the platforms. Guest money never sits with us

- If nothing books, we earn nothing

### What is billed at cost

Cleaning turns are paid by guests through the cleaning fee on every booking; it arrives in your payout and pays the cleaner at cost. Repairs, supplies and anything the home needs to be guest ready are billed to you at cost, with the receipt, and only after you approve the list. Your own costs, like utilities, insurance and your mortgage, stay yours, the same as with any manager.

The term and the notice to leave are quoted in writing after a [free look](https://listandhost.com/services/#free-look), before you sign anything. Stays already booked after the end date are honored.

## Questions owners ask about full service

**What does the fee cover, and what does it not?**

It covers everything it takes to run the rental: the listing and photo direction, daily pricing, every guest message, cleaning scheduling and checks, repair calls, reviews, claims and the monthly statement. It does not cover your own costs, like utilities, insurance and supplies, which are billed at cost with receipts. Guests pay the cleaning fee. Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it.

**Is there a setup fee or a launch fee?**

No. Launch is included in full service: the walkthrough, the listing, photo direction, pricing setup and your cleaner. Items the home needs to be guest ready are billed at cost after you approve the list.

**Do I keep control of my home?**

Yes. You block your own dates on the shared calendar any time, with two weeks notice so we can plan cleaning. You set a repair limit when we start, and anything over it comes to you with a quote first. A true emergency that puts the home or a guest at risk is handled right away, and you hear about it the same day.

**How and when do I get paid?**

The platforms pay you directly on their own schedules, so guest money never sits with us. By the 10th of each month we send your statement and one invoice for our fee and any costs paid for your home, with the receipts attached.

**My home is already on Airbnb. Can you take it over?**

Yes, and your reviews stay with the listing. Your listing stays in your own account and we join it as your host team. We usually improve pricing, photos and the description in the first weeks. If you would rather keep hosting yourself, [co hosting](https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/) may fit better.

**How much will my home earn?**

We never promise a number. The [instant estimator](https://listandhost.com/estimate/) shows a low to high range for homes like yours in your market, with its basis. The checked estimate from the application looks at your street, your listing if you have one, and the homes it competes with, and labels every figure as an estimate.

**How long is the agreement, and how do I leave?**

The term and the notice to leave are quoted in writing after a free look, before you sign anything. Stays already booked after the end date are honored.

**Do you manage homes outside Fort Worth, Dallas, Arlington and the Buffalo River region?**

Not full service. Full service needs our own cleaners and people on the ground. Elsewhere in the United States we offer [co hosting](https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/) and [remote pricing](https://listandhost.com/services/remote-pricing/), where you keep your local cleaner and we run the daily work from a distance.

# Airbnb and Vrbo Co Host Services

Source: https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/
Updated: 2026-10-18
Summary: Co hosting for short term rentals anywhere in the US. Keep your listing, cleaner and payouts; we run daily pricing, guest messages and cleaning schedules.

Co hosting means the owner keeps the listing, the reviews and the payouts, and keeps a local cleaner, while we run pricing, guest messages and the cleaning schedule as co host. You add us to your listing with the access you choose. Nothing moves out of your account.

The price is quoted in writing after a [free look](https://listandhost.com/services/#free-look): we read your listing and the homes it competes with first, then put the price, the term and the notice to leave in writing. You sign nothing to get it.

Three short steps, about two minutes, no phone number asked. Already listed? Paste your listing link in step 3 and the estimate is built on your own record, not the market average.

## Hosts who have the home covered and want the phone to stop

A co host cannot drive to your home. So co hosting works when someone local already can, and what you want off your plate is the pricing, the messages and the scheduling.

### Co hosting is usually right if

- You already list on Airbnb or Vrbo and have a cleaner you trust

- You, a neighbor or a handy person can get to the home for a lockout, a leak or a missing key

- Your prices are flat, or set once in a tool you stopped watching

- Guest messages wake you up, follow you on vacation, or wait hours for an answer

- Your home is anywhere in the United States, including outside our full service markets

### Look at another offer if

- Nobody near the home can handle hands on problems. In Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas and the Buffalo River region, that is [full service](https://listandhost.com/services/full-management/)

- Your messages are fine and only the prices are the problem: [remote pricing](https://listandhost.com/services/remote-pricing/) is the lighter option

- The home is not listed yet and you plan to host it yourself: start with the [setup and launch package](https://listandhost.com/services/setup-and-launch/)

- You rent a room inside the home you live in. We take on whole homes only

## What we do, and what stays with you

The split is simple: everything that happens on a screen is ours, everything that needs hands at the home is yours or your local person's.

### Ours as your co host

- Daily pricing by our engine, inside a floor you approve, with weekend and event prices, minimum stays and a fill plan for quiet weeks

- Every guest message, from the first question to checkout, every day of the week. Check in steps and reminders go by rule; a person answers the rest

- Your cleaner scheduled around every booking, with a checklist and a request for photos after each turn

- Calendars kept in sync on every channel you use, so a night sold on one closes on the others

- Every review answered, and a listing rewrite in the first month: title, first lines and photo order

- A monthly statement: nights, average rate, payouts by channel and every price change, with the reason

### Yours, or your local person's

- The listing, the reviews and the payouts stay in your account. The booking sites pay you as they do today

- Your cleaner and your cleaning fee. We never add a markup to anything at the home

- Repairs, supplies and anything that needs hands at the home. We tell you the moment a guest reports one

- Insurance that allows short term rental, and the home kept guest ready

- Blocking your own dates on the shared calendar, any time

How the pricing works, with floors, event weeks and gap nights: [dynamic pricing explained for owners](https://listandhost.com/blog/dynamic-pricing-explained-for-owners/). What a co host covers against a full manager, line by line: [solo co host vs full service](https://listandhost.com/compare/solo-co-host/).

## Access, payouts and what each site allows

### Airbnb

You add a co host from your listing and pick the access level: full access, calendar and messaging, or calendar only. We ask for full access so the engine can write prices and we can answer guests. Only the listing owner can set up or change a co host's payout share, so your money stays under your control.

### Vrbo and Booking.com

Co host access on Airbnb gives no access to the other sites. For Vrbo and Booking.com you add us as a user on each account, or we connect your listings to one calendar so every channel moves together. We tell you which fits your setup on the call.

### Your statement

By the 10th of each month: nights sold, average night, payouts by channel, every price change we made and why, and one invoice for our fee. The booking sites keep paying you directly. Guest money never sits with us.

## Anywhere in the United States

Co hosting runs from a distance, so it works wherever your cleaner does. These markets have their own page with seasons and typical rates: [Branson](https://listandhost.com/branson/), [Broken Bow](https://listandhost.com/broken-bow/), [Eureka Springs](https://listandhost.com/eureka-springs/), [Hot Springs](https://listandhost.com/hot-springs/), [Glen Rose and Granbury](https://listandhost.com/glen-rose-granbury/) and the [Texas Hill Country](https://listandhost.com/texas-hill-country/). In [Fort Worth](https://listandhost.com/fort-worth/), [Arlington](https://listandhost.com/arlington/), [Dallas](https://listandhost.com/dallas/) and the [Buffalo River region](https://listandhost.com/buffalo-river/) you can choose co hosting or full service.

## Questions hosts ask about co hosting

**What does an Airbnb co host do?**

A co host is someone the listing owner adds to help run the listing. Depending on the access the owner grants, a co host can set prices, update the calendar, edit the listing and message guests. With us, that means daily pricing by our engine, every guest message, the cleaning schedule and your reviews. The owner keeps the listing, the reviews and the payouts.

**How much does co hosting cost?**

Our price is quoted in writing after a free look: we read your listing and the homes it competes with, then send the price, the term and the notice to leave in writing. For context, one industry glossary puts typical co host pay at 10% to 30% of booking revenue, higher when the co host also handles cleaning and maintenance (Hostaway, 2026). Our full service fee, for comparison, is 20% of booking revenue.

**How does a co host get paid on Airbnb?**

Airbnb lets the listing owner share part of each payout with a co host, and only the listing owner can set up or change that share. Many owners prefer to keep the full payout and pay a monthly invoice instead. We send a statement by the 10th and one invoice; you choose which way it works for you.

**Do I lose my reviews or my Superhost status?**

No. Your listing stays in your account, so the reviews, the booking history and any status tied to the listing stay yours. We join as your host team.

**Does co hosting work on Vrbo?**

Yes, with a different mechanism. Vrbo has no co host button like Airbnb's, so you add us as a user on your account, or we connect your Vrbo and Airbnb listings to one calendar so every channel moves together. We tell you which fits your setup on the call.

**Who handles a problem at the home?**

You or your local person. A co host cannot drive to the home, so cleaning, repairs and lockouts stay with you. We tell you the moment a guest reports one, and we handle the guest side: the message, the apology, any refund you approve. If nobody near the home can do that, [full service](https://listandhost.com/services/full-management/) in our markets is the right offer.

**Can I start with only pricing?**

Yes. [Remote pricing](https://listandhost.com/services/remote-pricing/) is the lighter option: our engine prices your home every day and you keep every message. Hosts move from one to the other when they like.

**How do I find out if my listing would do better?**

Start with the [free 12 point listing audit](https://listandhost.com/free-listing-audit/): paste your listing link and within two business days you get a written review of your pricing, listing and setup, with the fixes ranked by what they are worth. No call needed.

## Get the daily work off your phone

Three short steps, about two minutes. Paste your listing link and the estimate is built on your own record. A written quote follows the free look. No phone number asked, and you sign nothing to get it.

# Airbnb Pricing Management, Run Remotely

Source: https://listandhost.com/services/remote-pricing/
Updated: 2026-10-18
Summary: Remote pricing for short term rentals anywhere in the US: our engine sets nightly rates and minimum stays every day inside your floor. You keep hosting.

Remote pricing means our engine sets the nightly rates and minimum stays for a home in any US market while the owner keeps local cleaning and upkeep. You keep the listing, the guests and the payouts. Every morning the engine reviews your next 12 months inside a floor you approve, and every change is logged with its reason.

The price is a monthly figure per listing, quoted in writing after a [free look](https://listandhost.com/services/#free-look). The term is quoted in writing after a free look as well. We read your listing and your market first, then put both in writing.

Three short steps, about two minutes, no phone number asked. Paste your listing link in step 3 and the estimate is built on your own record. An estimate with its basis, not a promise of income.

## Hosts who like hosting and run flat prices

Most self managed listings run one price all year, or a pricing tool set once and forgotten. The nights that cost the most are the ones nobody looked at: the event weekend sold at a weekday rate, the single night nobody could book, the quiet week that never got a fill price.

### Remote pricing is usually right if

- You already list on Airbnb, Vrbo or Booking.com and enjoy the guest side

- Your price is the same most nights, or your tool's settings have not changed in months

- You are not sure what nearby homes charge on your dates, or how your weekends compare

- Event weekends, holidays and gap nights slip past you

- Your home is anywhere in the United States, including outside our full service markets

### Look at another offer if

- Guest messages are the problem, not the prices: [co hosting](https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/) adds every message and the cleaning schedule

- Nobody near the home can handle hands on problems. In Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas and the Buffalo River region, that is [full service](https://listandhost.com/services/full-management/)

- The home is not listed yet: start with the [setup and launch package](https://listandhost.com/services/setup-and-launch/)

- You rent a room inside the home you live in. We take on whole homes only

## The same rules we run on the homes our team runs

You add us as a co host with full access so the engine can write prices. From then on, the engine and a person on our team do this.

### Every morning

- Every night for the next 12 months reviewed against your floor, your weekend and event prices and your minimum stays

- A fill plan for quiet weeks that steps prices down inside limits you approve, and never below your floor

- Gap nights opened or priced so a single night between two stays can sell

- Event nights and holidays locked at event prices, so no automatic cut can reach them

### Every week

- Your open nights checked against nearby homes on the same dates

- Underpriced stays raised and overpriced weekends adjusted, with the big moves approved by a person first

- Your discounts reviewed: last minute, weekly, monthly and early bird, and how they stack

- Every price change logged with its reason, so you can see what moved and why

### Every month, and once at the start

- A listing rewrite in the first month: title, first lines and photo order, written for how guests search

- A short monthly report: nights sold, average night, payouts by channel and what changed

- Your minimum stays, instant book, advance notice and trip length settings reviewed for the season ahead

- One invoice. The booking sites keep paying you directly

The method in full, with floors, event weeks and gap nights: [dynamic pricing explained for owners](https://listandhost.com/blog/dynamic-pricing-explained-for-owners/). How we price Fort Worth weekends and events: [pricing strategy for DFW weekends and events](https://listandhost.com/blog/airbnb-pricing-strategy-dfw-weekends-and-events/).

## What the engine will never do to your listing

### Never below your floor

You set the floor price when we start. No rule, no fill plan and no person on our team can write a price under it.

### Never a booked night

The engine prices open nights only. A night a guest has booked is never touched.

### Never an unlogged change

Each change is logged before it is written and read back after. If the read back does not match, our team gets an alert.

### Never a cut on event nights

Event nights and holidays you approve are locked. The only way they move is up, with a person's yes.

## What the engine did on the homes our team runs

We have no client results to show yet. This is the engine's own record, from our change log and booking records, with dates and the basis for every number.

### The engine's log

Half hourly checks of bookings, messages and prices**590 plus**

Price changes written and read back**133**

Minimum stay changes written and read back**52**

Months of nights reviewed every morning**12**

[How it works, step by step](https://listandhost.com/how-it-works/)

### One week of pricing calls

- **Event week.** The audit found the automatic fill rule set to cut the first week of a November event to $161 and $149 a night. Those nights now carry event prices and are locked, so no automatic cut can reach them.

- **Oct 13.** A check of nearby homes found three open stays cheaper than most of the market. They went up to near the median, and 23 winter and spring weekend nights, Dec 11 to Apr 10, moved to $299 or $319.

- **Result.** 24 of 31 October nights booked, up from 12 of 31 in August, as of October 16, 2026.

- **Oct 4.** A two night gap sat between two bookings on a new cabin listing. One night stays were allowed on both nights.

- **Oct 12.** A Vrbo guest booked both nights. The cabin then ran 13 nights in a row with no gaps, October 14 to the October 27 checkout.

- **Oct 7.** Two weekend nights that had no takers at $169 were cut on October 7 and booked within a week.

## Anywhere in the United States

Remote pricing works wherever your listing is. These markets have their own page with seasons, event dates and what homes there are listed at: [Branson](https://listandhost.com/branson/), [Broken Bow](https://listandhost.com/broken-bow/), [Eureka Springs](https://listandhost.com/eureka-springs/), [Hot Springs](https://listandhost.com/hot-springs/), [Glen Rose and Granbury](https://listandhost.com/glen-rose-granbury/) and the [Texas Hill Country](https://listandhost.com/texas-hill-country/). In [Fort Worth](https://listandhost.com/fort-worth/), [Arlington](https://listandhost.com/arlington/), [Dallas](https://listandhost.com/dallas/) and the [Buffalo River region](https://listandhost.com/buffalo-river/) you can choose remote pricing, co hosting or full service.

## Questions hosts ask about remote pricing

**How much does remote pricing cost?**

It is a monthly price per listing, quoted in writing after a free look. We read your listing and your market first, then send the price and the term in writing. You sign nothing to get the quote.

**How is this different from a pricing tool I can buy?**

A tool sets prices from its own model and leaves the settings to you. Here the same engine that prices the homes our team runs prices yours, inside a floor you approve, and a person checks nearby homes on your dates, approves the big moves and rewrites your listing in the first month. Every change is logged with its reason. If you already have a tool you trust and you check it weekly, keep it.

**Will you cut my price just to fill nights?**

Only inside limits you approve. The engine never sets a price below your floor, never touches a booked night, and locks event nights so no automatic cut can reach them. The fill plan for quiet weeks steps down by a set amount a week and stops at your floor.

**What access do you need?**

On Airbnb, you add us as a co host with full access so the engine can write prices and minimum stays. On Vrbo and Booking.com you add us as a user, or we connect your listings to one calendar. We never need your login. You keep the listing, the guests and the payouts.

**Do you answer my guests too?**

Not in remote pricing. You keep every message. If you want the messages and the cleaning schedule handled as well, that is [co hosting](https://listandhost.com/services/co-hosting/), and hosts move between the two when they like.

**Does it work for one listing?**

Yes. Most hosts who ask have one home. The price is per listing.

**How do I know if my prices are the problem?**

Start with the [free 12 point listing audit](https://listandhost.com/free-listing-audit/): paste your listing link and within two business days you get a written review of your pricing, listing and setup, with the fixes ranked by what they are worth. Five of the twelve points are about price.

## Put the engine on your listing

Three short steps, about two minutes. Paste your listing link and the estimate is built on your own record. A written quote follows the free look. No phone number asked, and you sign nothing to get it.

[Start my checked estimate](https://listandhost.com/apply/?lean=remote)

Prefer to look first? Read [dynamic pricing explained for owners](https://listandhost.com/blog/dynamic-pricing-explained-for-owners/) or [compare running it yourself with hiring help](https://listandhost.com/compare/self-managing/).


# Airbnb Management Pricing, Fees and Payouts

Source: https://listandhost.com/pricing/
Updated: 2026-10-19
Summary: What full service costs, what it covers, what is billed at cost and how payouts reach you. No setup fee, no markup. Other offers quoted in writing.

Full service is 20% of booking revenue. No setup fee, no markup on repairs or supplies, and the platforms pay guest money straight to you, never to us.

The estimator shows a low to high range for a home like yours. It is an estimate with its basis, not a promise of income.

20% of booking revenue

Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it.

- No setup fee. Launch is included

- No fee on cleaning fees or taxes

- No fee on nights you block for yourself

- Repairs and supplies at cost, with receipts

- Payouts go straight to you from the platforms

Full service in Fort Worth, DFW and the Buffalo River region. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the US.

## Everything it takes to run the rental

One fee covers the daily work. You approve your floor price, your repair limit and anything big. We run the rest.

### Listing and pricing

- Listing written for how guests search, with the photo shoot directed by us

- Live on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com on one calendar

- Prices set every day by our engine, inside a floor you approve

- Weekend and event prices, minimum stays and a fill plan for quiet weeks

### Guests and the home

- Every guest message, from the first question to checkout

- Check in steps, house rules and quiet hours

- Local cleaners scheduled around every stay, with a checklist and photos

- Repairs by trusted local pros. Anything over your limit comes to you first

### Money and reporting

- Reviews answered, and damage claims filed with the platform on time

- A monthly statement by the 10th

- An online view with nights booked ahead, upcoming stays and open nights is being built. [See an example](https://listandhost.com/owner-dashboard/)

- Launch included: walkthrough, listing, pricing setup and cleaner

## What is billed at cost, and who pays it

Running a home has costs no matter who manages it. Here is where each one goes. We never add a markup.

| Cost | Who pays | Where you see it |
| - | - | - |
| Cleaning turns | Guests, through the cleaning fee on every booking. It arrives in your payout and pays the cleaner, at cost. | Your statement, turn by turn |
| Repairs | You, at cost. Anything over your repair limit comes to you with a quote first. | Your statement, with the receipt |
| Supplies and restocking | You, at cost | Your statement, with the receipt |
| Getting guest ready | You, at cost, and only after you approve the setup list: linens, a smart lock or lockbox, furniture if the home needs it | Your statement, with the receipt |
| Platform host fees | Taken by each platform before it pays you | Your statement. Our fee is worked out after them |
| Utilities, WiFi, insurance, your mortgage | You, the same as with any manager | Your own bills |

**Never charged:** a setup fee for full service, a markup on repairs or supplies, our fee on cleaning fees or taxes, or our fee on nights you block for yourself.

## How the money moves

Guest money goes to you, not through us. Once a month you get the full picture and one invoice.

### A guest books

On Airbnb, Vrbo or Booking.com. One calendar, so a night sold on one closes on the others.

### The platform pays you

Straight to your own account, on each platform's own schedule, after its host fee. Guest money never sits with us.

### Your statement, by the 10th

Every booking by check in date with nights, channel and payout, every cost at cost, and our fee with exactly what it was taken from.

### One invoice

For our fee and any costs paid for your home, with the receipts attached.

Sample statement

Cleaning, 7 turns at cost**−$700**

Our fee, 20% of $4,900 nightly revenue**−$980**

Left for you, before your own costs**$3,920**

**What is a free look?** A free look is the 15 minute call or the free listing audit, whichever you prefer. We look at your home or your listing and the homes it competes with, then send the price, the term and the notice to leave in writing. It costs nothing and you sign nothing.

## Straight answers on what it costs

**What counts as booking revenue?**

Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it. We earn nothing on nights you block for yourself.

**Is there a setup fee?**

Not for full service. Launch is included: the walkthrough, the listing, photo direction, pricing setup and your cleaner. Items the home needs to be guest ready are billed at cost, after you approve the list.

**Do you take a fee on the cleaning fee?**

No. Guests pay the cleaning fee on every booking and it pays the cleaner, at cost. Our 20% is worked out on booking revenue only.

**Do you mark up repairs or supplies?**

No. Repairs and supplies are billed at cost, with the receipts. You set a repair limit when we start, and anything over it comes to you with a quote first.

**How and when do I get paid?**

The platforms pay you directly, on their own schedules, so guest money never sits with us. By the 10th of each month we send your statement and one invoice for our fee and any costs.

**What will I see each month?**

By the 10th, a statement for your home with payouts, costs and every stay by check in date. An online view with nights booked ahead, upcoming stays and open nights is being built. Anything that needs your yes comes to you by email when it comes up. [See an example of that view](https://listandhost.com/owner-dashboard/), built from the homes our team runs.

**How long is the agreement?**

The term and the notice to leave are quoted in writing after a free look, before you sign anything. Stays already booked after the end date are honored.

**How much will my home earn?**

We never promise a number. The [instant estimator](https://listandhost.com/estimate/) shows a low to high range for homes like yours, labeled as an estimate with its basis. A person on our team can check it for free.

**Do you pay for referrals?**

For real estate agents, yes. If an agent refers an owner who signs, we pay $500 to the agent’s brokerage at the owner’s first payout. [How agent referrals work](https://listandhost.com/refer/).

**Where do you offer full service?**

Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

Pick your market and bedrooms and see a low to high range in seconds. It is an estimate, not a promise.

# How It Works: Pricing Engine and Dashboard

Source: https://listandhost.com/how-it-works/
Updated: 2026-10-19
Summary: How our pricing and messaging engine runs a rental every day, what a person still decides, what owners see on the statement, and the view we are building.

Every home our team runs is on our own pricing and messaging engine. It checks bookings, messages and prices all day, writes every change through one channel manager and reads it back. A person decides anything that needs judgment. You see all of it.

**590+** half hourly checks, Sep 21 to Oct 16, 2026

**133** price changes and 52 minimum stay changes written and read back

**12** months of nights reviewed every morning

## What runs your home every day

The same rules run on every home. Your floor price and your approvals set the limits.

### Every 30 minutes

Checks every booking, guest message and calendar night on every channel. New bookings, cancellations and questions show up within the half hour.

### Every morning

Reviews prices for the next 12 months. Applies your floor, weekend and event prices, minimum stays and a fill plan for quiet weeks, then writes the changes.

### Every stay

Sends what each guest needs by rule: check in steps before arrival, a checkout reminder, then a review and a thank you note. Anything else goes to a person.

### Hard limits

Never sets a price below your floor. Never touches a booked night. Locks event nights so no automatic cut can reach them. Big moves wait for a yes.

### Every change checked

Each price change is logged before it is made and read back after. If the read back does not match, it raises an alert to our team.

### A watcher on the watcher

A supervisor checks the engine twice a day, and a daily audit looks for anything that slipped through.

The full method, with floors, event weeks and gap nights: [dynamic pricing explained for owners](https://listandhost.com/blog/dynamic-pricing-explained-for-owners/).

## One week in October, on the homes our team runs

This is what the engine and the people behind it actually did, taken from our own change log.

### Event week protected

An audit found the automatic fill rule was set to cut the first week of the NCHA Futurity to $161 and $149 a night. Those nights were locked at event prices the same day.

### Underpriced stays raised

A check of nearby homes found three open stays cheaper than most of the market. With the owner's yes they went up to near the median, and 23 winter and spring weekend nights, Dec 11 to Apr 10, moved up to $299 or $319.

### A new cabin filled

A new cabin listing took three stays in three days at its launch prices and booked every night from Oct 14 to the Oct 27 checkout. The next moves there are raises.

See the full Fort Worth review in our [sample listing audit](https://listandhost.com/free-listing-audit/#sample).

## The engine, our team and you

| Job | The engine | Our team | You |
| - | - | - | - |
| Nightly prices | Sets them every morning inside your floor | Checks nearby homes and approves big moves | Approve your floor |
| Guest messages | Sends check in steps, checkout reminders and thank you notes | Answers every question and anything unusual | Nothing |
| Cleaning | Logs every turnover | Schedules the cleaner and checks the photos | Nothing |
| Repairs | Not involved | Calls a trusted pro, sends you a quote over your limit | Approve repairs over your limit |
| Money | Builds the monthly statement | Checks it against real payouts | Get paid by the platforms |
| Your own stays | Blocks the dates | Plans cleaning around them | Pick the dates |

3. **March: $3,500

8. **August: $2,900

11. **November: $3,300

Best months: May, March and December, 28 percent of the year. Slowest: February and September.

**How this number is built**

Basis: AirROI public market data for Fort Worth, TX, Aug 2025 to Jul 2026, 1,607 active listings, spread across sizes with that market's own bedroom mix. June and July 2026 were replaced with the average of May and August, because the nine World Cup matches at the Arlington stadium (June 14 to July 14, 2026) pushed those months far above a normal year. This lowers the yearly figures by 4 percent. The average listing there, all sizes, earned $24,276 a year; many listings are not open every night. Cross checks: Airbtics shows a $184 average nightly rate and 61 percent booked for Sep 2025 to Aug 2026. Red Awning shows $285 a night for a 3 bedroom home. Sources: [AirROI, Fort Worth, TX, Aug 2025 to Jul 2026](https://www.airroi.com/airbnb-data/united-states/texas/fort-worth) · [Red Awning, Fort Worth nightly rate by bedroom count](https://www.redawning.com/pm/airbnb-management-cities/fort-worth-texas) · [BNBCalc, Fort Worth market page, cleaning fee by bedroom count](https://www.bnbcalc.com/markets/us/fort-worth-tx) · [Airbtics, Fort Worth, Sep 2025 to Aug 2026](https://airbtics.com/annual-airbnb-revenue-in-fort-worth-texas-usa) · [FOX 4, the nine World Cup matches at the Arlington stadium, June 14 to July 14, 2026](https://www.fox4news.com/news/2026-fifa-world-cup-att-stadium-schedule).

### What each case leaves you

| Per year | Low | Likely | High |
| - | - | - | - |
| Gross bookings for the nights | $31,100 | $38,700 | $50,400 |
| Platform fees and discounts, about 19 percent | −$5,816 | −$7,237 | −$9,425 |
| After platform fees and discounts | $25,284 | $31,463 | $40,975 |
| Our fee, 20 percent | −$5,057 | −$6,293 | −$8,195 |
| Left for you, before your own costs | $20,227 | $25,170 | $32,780 |

Platform fees and discounts, measured on our own bookings: 75 accepted stays at the three homes our team runs, check in dates from July 2026 to June 2027, as booked on October 16, 2026. For each stay we compared the platform payout, before tax, with what guests were charged at list price for the nights, cleaning and pet fees. The gap is the platform's host fee plus any discount or refund. Airbnb kept 19.9 percent (64 stays), Vrbo 8.0 percent (9 stays), or 11.2 percent after the 3.5 percent payment cut we see on Vrbo deposits, and Booking.com 15.0 percent (2 stays, a small sample). Weighted by what guests were charged, that is 18.7 percent, the figure this estimate takes off before our fee. Your own costs (mortgage, utilities, insurance, supplies and repairs) are not included.

### What moved your number

- Start: a 3 bedroom home in Fort Worth runs about $250 a night with 42 percent of nights booked in the likely case (AirROI, size adjusted).

- No changes for guests, baths or extras.

### Homes our team runs here

- The 3 bedroom Fort Worth home our team runs near the Stockyards and Dickies Arena, sleeps 8: 56 of 92 nights booked (61 percent), average $179 a night. Aug 1 to Oct 31, 2026, October as booked on Oct 16.

October is not over: its nights are booked, not yet stayed. Average nightly rate is what guests paid per night after discounts, before cleaning fees. Three months is a short record and fall is a strong season, so treat these as a record of homes our team runs, not as your number.

## How we build the estimate

- **Market data.** For each market we use AirROI's public figures for the 12 months from August 2025 to July 2026: average nightly rate, the share of nights booked, revenue per open night by percentile, cleaning fees and the month by month pattern.

- **Size.** Each market's average is spread across bedroom counts using that market's own mix of homes. The size scale matches AirROI's bedroom data for Broken Bow, where 2 bedrooms average $323 a night and 4 bedrooms $575.

- **Three cases.** Low is the middle listing in the market. Likely is the market average per open night. High is the top quarter.

- **Your home.** Guest count, baths, a hot tub and pets move the number a little. Each change is listed with its basis, and the ones that are our own assumptions say so.

- **One fix for Dallas, Fort Worth and Arlington.** June and July 2026 held nine World Cup matches at the Arlington stadium. We replaced those two months with a normal summer so the estimate is not inflated.

- **Checked against the homes our team runs.** The Fort Worth home booked about $109 per open night from August to October 2026 (October as booked on October 16), between the likely and high cases for its size. The glass house in the Buffalo River region booked about twice the high case for its size over the same months, because it is one of a kind.

## Questions owners ask

**Is this a promise of income?**

No. It is an estimate from market data. Your street, photos, reviews, house rules and how the home is run all move the real number. Send your address for a checked estimate. Buying a home to rent? Read [the numbers to check before you buy](https://listandhost.com/blog/buying-a-short-term-rental-numbers-to-check/).

**Why is it above the market average listing?**

Many listings are not open every night. Owners block dates, take breaks or only list part of the year. The estimate assumes your home is open all year.

**Does it include the cleaning fee?**

No. Guests pay the cleaning fee and it goes to the cleaner, so the yearly figure leaves it out.

**What if my market is not on the list?**

Pick Somewhere else in the US for a starting point, then send your address. We run pricing, listings and guest messages from one system. Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

Read [the numbers to check before you buy](https://listandhost.com/blog/buying-a-short-term-rental-numbers-to-check/).

## The same engine behind all three

### Daily pricing with floors

A full pricing pass every morning. Every change is checked against a floor, read back after it is written, and logged.

### Event calendar

Concerts, games, holidays and peak seasons get their own floors and minimum stays, set months ahead.

### Fill ladder and gap filling

Open nights step down slowly as the date nears, and single nights between bookings open up to one night stays.

### Fast guest answers

Check in details go out on their own. Routine questions get a drafted answer a person approves. Money, damage or safety always goes to a person.

### Review care

Guests are reviewed the day they leave and thanked. Five star reviews get a public reply. Anything less gets a careful reply a person approves.

### A person approves big moves

Large price changes and any message outside the routine go out only after a one word approval.

**How we counted these numbers**

Nights and nightly rates come from our booking records for each stay. Average night is what guests paid for the nights after discounts, before cleaning fees, taxes and platform fees. Share of nights is nights booked divided by all nights in the month.

Payouts are what the platforms pay after their own fees. They include the guest cleaning fee and come before cleaning and other costs. Our management fee is never charged on the cleaning fee. Each payout is counted in the month it is due, the day after check in. A payout cut by a refund is counted when it was paid, and taxes a platform passes through are left out. Vrbo payouts not yet deposited are estimated at the platform figure less 3.5 percent until the deposit lands.

Ratings, review counts, Guest Favorite status and response rate were read from the public Airbnb listing on October 16, 2026. Other review counts come from our review records across Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com. Every number is as of October 16, 2026. Past results from these homes are not a promise of what another home will earn.

# Free Airbnb Listing Audit, 12 Point Review

Source: https://listandhost.com/free-listing-audit/
Updated: 2026-10-18
Summary: Already hosting? Send your listing link and get a free written 12 point audit of your pricing, listing and setup, with the fixes worth the most money.

Send us your listing link. Within two business days we email a written audit of your pricing, your listing and your setup, with the fixes ranked by what they are worth.

- Your nights checked against nearby homes on the same dates

- Each point rated Pass, Fix or Watch, in plain words

- Dollar estimates for the top fixes, with the basis shown

- No cost, no call needed, and it is yours to keep

## The 12 points

The same checks we run on the homes our team runs. Pricing comes first, because that is where most hosts lose the most money.

### Pricing

1. **Price against nearby homes.** Your next 90 days against comparable homes on the same dates.

2. **Weekend and weekday split.** Whether your weekends earn what the market pays.

3. **Event nights and holidays.** Concerts, games, festivals and holidays priced as the big nights they are.

4. **Discounts.** Last minute, weekly, monthly and early bird discounts, and how they stack.

5. **Minimum stays and gap nights.** Rules that leave single nights unsold.

### Listing

1. **Fees and the total guests see.** Cleaning, extra guest and pet fees against nearby homes.

2. **Title and first lines.** Written for what guests type, not clever phrases.

3. **Photos and accuracy.** Your first five photos, and anything guests say the listing got wrong.

4. **Reviews.** Your rating, what guests repeat, and how you answer.

### Setup

1. **Channels and calendar.** Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and how they stay in sync.

2. **Booking settings.** Instant book, cancellation policy, advance notice and trip length.

3. **Guest messages.** Check in steps, checkout, review follow up and how fast questions get answered.

Background on two of the points: [Airbnb ranking and Guest Favorite](https://listandhost.com/blog/airbnb-ranking-and-guest-favorite/) and [dynamic pricing](https://listandhost.com/blog/dynamic-pricing-explained-for-owners/). Prefer we run it for you? See [co hosting and remote pricing](https://listandhost.com/services/).

## We ran the audit on a home our team runs

A 3 bedroom home near Dickies Arena and the Stockyards in Fort Worth that sleeps 8, October 2026. Nearby homes come from a live search of 12 to 14 comparable 3 and 4 bedroom homes on Oct 13, 2026. Everything else comes from our own booking records and change log.

**6** Pass

**3** Fixed the same week

**2** Fix next

**1** Watch

| # | Point | What we found | What we did | Rating |
| - | - | - | - | - |
| 1 | Price against nearby homes | Three open stays were cheaper than most nearby homes. Halloween weekend was $670 for the stay against a $754 median. Nov 20 to 21 was $668 against $800. Thanksgiving was $560 against $744. | Raised to $379, $339 and $319 a night, which puts each stay near the median. | Fixed |
| 2 | Weekend and weekday split | Two fall weekends sold at about $209 and $248 a night, while homes still open those weekends asked a median of $1,618 and $1,010 for the stay. Leftover homes skew high, but the gap was too wide to ignore. | Raised 23 winter and spring weekend nights, Dec 11 to Apr 10, to $299 or $319. Any still open 30 days out get a second look. | Fixed |
| 3 | Event nights and holidays | The NCHA Futurity fills Fort Worth from mid November to mid December. The automatic fill rule had planned to cut its first week to $161 and $149 a night. | Futurity weeks and the Texas EMS Conference nights now carry event prices and are locked, so no automatic cut can reach them. | Fixed |
| 4 | Discounts | A 10% weekly, a 25% monthly and a 15% last minute discount can stack. Some late booked 7 and 28 night stays land under the $125 guest price floor. | A four week stay comes to about $3,100 before cleaning. The owner chose to keep that price for monthly guests, so it stays on the watch list. | Watch |
| 5 | Minimum stays and gap nights | Friday, Saturday and Sunday need two nights. Monday to Thursday allow one, so a single gap night between stays can still sell. | No change. | Pass |
| 6 | Fees and the total guests see | The cleaning fee is $110 for a home that sleeps 8, and it is part of the stay total guests compare in search. | No change. | Pass |
| 7 | Title and first lines | The title leads with Dickies, TCU and the Stockyards. Guests also name the Convention Center in reviews, and the title does not. | Test the Convention Center in the title or the first line. | Fix |
| 8 | Photos and accuracy | Two four star reviews mention parking. The garage is tight for two cars and the driveway fits one. | Say exactly how many cars fit, in the listing and in the check in message. | Fix |
| 9 | Reviews | 4.9 stars from 14 reviews. Guests repeat the same things: clean, close to everything, quick answers, great beds. One wrote: “Great spot and great location!” (Guest, Oct 2026) | Every guest gets a review and a thank you note. Five star reviews get a public reply. | Pass |
| 10 | Channels and calendar | Live on Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and a direct booking site, all on one calendar. A night sold on one closes on the others. | No change. | Pass |
| 11 | Booking settings | Instant book is on for all three platforms. Cancellation on Airbnb is Firm. | No change. | Pass |
| 12 | Guest messages | Check in steps, checkout reminders and review notes go out by rule. Questions the templates do not cover go to a person. | No change. | Pass |

**What the fixes are worth, as an estimate:** about $390 more on the three stays in point 1, and about $1,490 more on the 23 weekend nights in point 2, if they sell at the new list prices. A higher price can also slow bookings, so we watch those nights and review any still open 30 days out.

# Airbnb Management FAQ: 20 Owner Questions

Source: https://listandhost.com/faq/
Updated: 2026-10-18
Summary: Straight answers to the 20 questions owners ask before hiring a short term rental manager: fees, payouts, control, pricing, guests and contracts.

Updated October 18, 2026

The short version: full service is 20% of booking revenue, the booking platforms pay you directly, and you can block your own dates any time. The 20 answers below cover fees, payouts, control, pricing, guests and getting started. If yours is not here, ask it on a short call.

## What does it cost, and how do I get paid?

**How much does full service cost?**

20% of booking revenue. Booking revenue is the nightly rent and any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. It leaves out taxes and cleaning fees. We earn nothing on nights you block for yourself. Every fee and cost is on our [pricing page](https://listandhost.com/pricing/).

**What is the difference between full service and co hosting?**

Full service covers everything, including local cleaners and repairs, for 20%. Co hosting is for hosts who keep their own cleaner and handle anything at the home, while we run the listing, prices and guest messages for a price quoted in writing after a [free look](https://listandhost.com/services/#free-look). Both run on the same engine.

**Is there a setup fee?**

Not for full service. Launch is included. If you only want help going live and plan to host yourself, the launch package is a one time price, quoted in writing after a free look.

**Who pays for cleaning?**

Guests do, through the cleaning fee on every booking. That fee goes to the cleaner.

**Do you mark up repairs or supplies?**

No. Repairs and supplies are billed at cost, with the receipts.

**How and when do I get paid?**

The platforms pay you directly, so guest money never sits with us. By the 10th of each month we send your statement and an invoice for our fee.

**How much can my home earn?**

It depends on the home, the market and the season, so we never promise a number. Ask for a free estimate and we send a low to high range built from comparable listings and public market data, with the basis for every number.

## Who stays in control of the home?

**Can I still use my home?**

Yes. Block your dates on the shared calendar. Any night no guest has booked is yours. We ask for two weeks notice so we can plan cleaning.

**Who approves repairs?**

You set a repair limit when we start. We suggest $250. Anything over it comes to you with a quote first. A true emergency that puts the home or a guest at risk gets handled right away, and you hear about it the same day.

**My home is already listed. Do I lose my reviews?**

No. Your listing stays in your own account and we join it as your host team, so the reviews and the booking history stay yours.

**How long is the agreement, and how do I leave?**

The term and the notice to leave are quoted in writing after a free look, before you sign anything. Stays already booked after the end date are honored.

## How are prices set and guests handled?

**How do you set prices?**

Each morning our engine reviews every night for the next 12 months. It works from your floor price, weekend and event prices, minimum stays and a fill plan for quiet weeks. A person checks nearby homes and approves the big moves.

**Will you cut my price just to fill nights?**

Only inside limits you approve. The engine never sets a price below your floor, never touches a booked night, and locks event nights so no automatic cut can reach them.

**How fast do guests get answers?**

Every message gets an answer, every day of the week. Check in steps, checkout reminders and thank you notes go out by rule. Questions go to a person on our team.

**How do you protect my home?**

Clear house rules and quiet hours, the platforms' own guest verification, and a cleaner who checks and photographs the home after every stay. If something is damaged, we document it and file the claim with the platform on time.

**Which platforms do you list on?**

Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, kept on one calendar so a night sold on one closes on the others. Each one reaches different travelers.

## How do we get started?

**What areas do you serve?**

Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

**How long until my home is live?**

About 14 days from signing for a furnished home. A home that needs furniture or repairs takes longer, and we tell you how long on day one.

**What does my home need before the first guest?**

Furniture and linens for everyone it sleeps, WiFi, a smart lock or lockbox, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, a fire extinguisher, and insurance that allows short term rental. We send one setup list after the walkthrough.

**How many homes does your team run?**

Three today: a glass house and a cabin loft in the Buffalo River region, and a 3 bedroom home in Fort Worth. The glass house is a Guest Favorite rated 4.9. Your home would run on the same engine. We are a small team, so you deal directly with the people who run it. Who we are and how we count every number is on our [about page](https://listandhost.com/about/).

## Still have a question?

Ask it on a 15 minute call. We answer straight, and we tell you if we are not the right fit.

[Request a 15 minute call](https://listandhost.com/book-a-call/)


# Agent Referrals: $500 per Signed Home

Source: https://listandhost.com/refer/
Updated: 2026-10-18
Summary: Agents: refer an owner to List & Host and your brokerage earns $500 (as of October 2026) when they sign, paid at the first payout. Ask the owner first.

For real estate agents. Introduce us to an owner whose home could rent short term, like a seller whose home is slow to sell. If they sign with List & Host, we pay $500 to your brokerage at the owner's first payout. It costs the owner nothing.

1. **Ask the owner first.** Make sure they are happy to hear from us.

2. **Send us their details.** Use this form, or email them with us copied.

3. **We take it from there.** A free estimate, and a short call only if they want one. No pressure.

4. **They sign, your brokerage is paid.** $500 at the owner's first payout.

## Simple, and in plain words

### $500 per signed home

Paid to your brokerage at the owner's first payout after they sign with us.

### For real estate agents

The referral payment is for licensed real estate agents and goes to the agent's brokerage. Anyone else who knows an owner can point them to our [free estimate](https://listandhost.com/estimate/).

### Owners we serve

Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

### Only with their okay

We contact a referred owner only if they agreed to hear from us, and a no thanks ends it. We never pressure anyone to sign.

### Never for a review

Referral payments are never tied to reviews or ratings. We never pay or offer anything for a review.

### No promises of income

We send the owner an estimate with its basis. We never promise what a home will earn, and you do not need to either.

## A note you can forward

Copy it into an email of your own, or open it in your email with us copied. When the owner replies, we take it from there.

I know a small team that runs short term rentals called List & Host. They list the home, set prices every day, handle guests and cleaning, and send a monthly statement. Full service is 20% of booking revenue with no setup fee. You can see results from homes they run at listandhost.com/results and get a free estimate at listandhost.com/estimate. If you sign with them, they pay my brokerage a $500 referral.

You can change the words. Please keep the numbers and the referral line as they are.

### Two ways to send it

Email it with us copied

Prefer to tell us yourself? Write to team@listandhost.com.

## Quick answers

**Who can earn the referral?**

Licensed real estate agents. The $500 is paid to your brokerage. Anyone can point an owner to our [free estimate](https://listandhost.com/estimate/), but the referral payment is for agents only.

**When is the $500 paid?**

At the owner's first payout after they sign with us, to your brokerage. We tell you by email when they sign.

**What if the owner does not sign?**

Then there is no payment, and no hard feelings. We send the owner an estimate and answer questions, and we never pressure anyone.

**Will you contact a referred owner without their okay?**

No. Send us only owners who agreed to hear from us. We write to them by email, and if they say no thanks, that is the end of it.

**Can I refer my own sellers?**

Yes. An owner whose home is slow to sell can keep it listed and rent it while it sells, or rent it instead of selling. Your seller stays your client and the listing agreement does not change. If they sign with us, we pay the $500 to your brokerage.

**Is this tied to reviews?**

No. Referral payments are never tied to reviews or ratings, and we never pay or offer anything for a review.

**What does the owner pay?**

Full service is 20% of booking revenue with no setup fee. Every cost is on our [pricing page](https://listandhost.com/pricing/).

## Know an owner with a home?

Two minutes of your time. $500 to your brokerage when they sign.

Refer an owner
